content:
Ashok: Quick sync — for the new sg2 region we want route-by-residency: traffic from SG/TW should prefer sg2; fallback to sg if capacity limited. Who owns the routing policy + prefix lists? Also DB replica promotion + KMS residency — who owns the data-residency checklist? Need to unblock infra PRs. pinging @maria @kevin @elaine

Maria: I can take ownership of the routing policy and prefix lists. I'll draft a routing PR with config + tests. Need the expected capacity/SLOs and explicit fallback rules to include. @kevin can you confirm the fallback thresholds?

Kevin: I can provide numbers. From capacity planning SG2 initial pool = 2xA100 (reserved) — roughly ~120 rps at 512 tokens. Proposed fallback policy: prefer sg2, if per-request latency (p50) > 120ms OR queue depth > 500 then route to sg; if sg also congested, route to hosted-default. Example config snippet I'll add to the PR:
```yaml
routes:
  - match: region == "SG"
    prefer: sg2
    fallback: [sg, hosted-default]
    thresholds:
      latency_ms: 120
      queue_depth: 500
```

Elaine: Security note — KMS keys for sg2 must be region-scoped and we need KMS replication/GRANTs set up before enabling protected workloads. For DB: we should start with read-only replica in sg2; promotion only during a planned cutover window with DB-owner signoff. I'll need to be added to the runbook for verification steps. Also: ensure logs carry residency tags.

platform-bot: deploy-checker — infra PR #4572 failed sg2 staging smoke: kv-store mount error. CI link: https://ci.internal/4572 (log attached).

Ashok: Thanks. Maria — can you own the routing PR + include the fallback thresholds from Kevin? Kevin — please post perf numbers (p50/p95, token throughput) in that PR. Elaine — I'll add you to the runbook draft; please add KMS and DB promotion checks. Target ETA: PRs open by next Wed EOD so we can schedule canary.

Maria: Will open PR by Mon EOD. I'll include test plan, canary steps, and explicit thresholds (latency=120ms, queue=500, token-backpressure=8). Also adding a small smoke job to CI that runs sg2 routing rules against sample traffic.

Kevin: I'll upload perf CSV + raw p50/p95 numbers to the PR by Tue morning. Also: recommend adding a metric alert on `routing.fallbacks.count` > 5/min for first 24h post-cutover.

Elaine: Reviewing runbook/KMS section once you add it. One security ask: include a KMS key ARN pattern check and a rotation verification step in the post-cutover checklist.

Ashok: Perfect. If anyone needs pairing time, drop a 30m on my calendar; otherwise owners = Maria (routing), Kevin (perf numbers + alerts), Elaine (security/runbook). I'll follow up in this thread when PRs are open. :thumbsup:

Maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4620 — includes routing config + smoke job. Please review and leave approvals.

Kevin: Reviewing now, will push perf artifacts shortly.

Elaine: Adding KMS block to PR review.

Ashok: Thanks all — syncing channel once reviewers + CI green.
